script_text: Stop, Aquarius: the sky just pulled a fast one on your Air sign. Jupiter has entered your 6th House of work, health, and daily systems in Cancer, trining Neptune in your 3rd House and sextiling your ruler Uranus in Taurus. Venus in the 6th also opposes Pluto in your 1st House, while Mars in your 3rd trines Pluto, sharpening your words and your instincts. In love, this is magnetic but volatile: if you're taken, a schedule or body-image comment can become a power struggle; if single, attraction may come through a coworker, gym, or health appointment. For career and money, Jupiter in the 6th can bring a better client, paid side task, or improved routine, but Saturn in your 2nd House says don't overextend your budget. Avoid signing a romantic or financial ultimatum under Venus opposite Pluto. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
